b0ab8af8-cb28-465a-aea7-5d32bec5ae19@nin.why: The 49ers arrive at 7-1, first in the NFC West, while Dallas is below .500 at 4-5 and fighting to stay in the playoff picture. It is only Week 10, so neither a win nor a loss decides anything by itself, but beating a struggling NFC team would further cement San Francisco's spot atop its division and build toward a playoff seed later.
b0ab8af8-cb28-465a-aea7-5d32bec5ae19@nin.know: NFC West is one of the NFL's eight divisions, winning it (or just making the broader playoff bracket) is the regular season goal. Watch running back Christian McCaffrey, who creates big plays for San Francisco's offense, and Dallas quarterback Dak Prescott, who needs a strong game to keep the Cowboys' season from slipping further.

fe74ebe2-bd22-454c-bd51-783a4e7a50cf@ufc.why: Former light heavyweight champ Jiri Prochazka looks to rebound after an April title-fight knockout loss, while unbeaten rising prospect Navajo Stirling, fresh off stopping ex-champ Jan Blachowicz, tries to prove he belongs among the elite. In the co-main, former bantamweight champ Aljamain Sterling, now up at featherweight, meets surging contender Kevin Vallejos, with the winner moving closer to a title shot at 145 pounds.
fe74ebe2-bd22-454c-bd51-783a4e7a50cf@ufc.know: UFC rankings run #1 to #15 in each weight class below the champion; beating a higher-ranked foe builds a case for a title shot, the chance to fight for the belt. A Fight Night card has no title bout but is a good place to spot fighters who may soon reach title contention.

afce88a5-30fa-41f5-be6d-38cadb4fe552@nin.why: San Francisco enters at 7-1 and in first place in the NFC West, hosting a Minnesota team at 6-2 that started 6-0 before dropping two straight. It is Week 11, so no clinching or elimination math applies yet, but it is a measuring-stick game against a real playoff contender. A win keeps the 49ers rolling toward a top playoff seed; a loss would be their second in a row and a warning sign against good teams.
afce88a5-30fa-41f5-be6d-38cadb4fe552@nin.know: The teams are in different divisions (NFC West vs NFC North) but same conference, so results here can still affect playoff tiebreakers based on conference record. Watch Christian McCaffrey, San Francisco's versatile running back who can beat you running or catching passes, and Justin Jefferson, Minnesota's top wide receiver who creates big plays whenever he is healthy.
